question.worked_solution:
First, we rearrange our equation to isolate the logarithmic term:

$$
\begin{aligned}-6{log}_{3}⁡(x-3) & =-24 \\ {log}_{3}⁡(x-3) & =\frac{-24}{-6} \\ {log}_{3}⁡(x-3) & =4\end{aligned}
$$

To remove the logarithm, we exponentiate both sides of the equation. The base of the logarithm is $3,$ so we use this base for the exponentiation as well:

$$
\begin{aligned}{log}_{3}⁡(x-3) & =4 \\ {3}^{{log}_{3}⁡(x-3)} & ={3}^{4}\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since exponentiation is the inverse function of the logarithm, we get ${3}^{{log}_{3}⁡(x-3)}=x-3.$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}x-3 & ={3}^{4} \\ x-3 & =81 \\ x & =84.\end{aligned}
$$
